primary: advanced agent users delivering research, product, writing, analysis, and software outcomes
audience.jobToBeDone: Give a goal to a local AI team, keep execution controllable, and receive a usable, traceable, verifiable delivery.

primaryNavigation.label: Inbox
primaryNavigation.description: Inputs, approvals, blockers, failures, and deliveries that need the user.

primaryNavigation.label: Work
primaryNavigation.description: Goals, active work, projects, milestones, and high-signal progress.

primaryNavigation.label: Team
primaryNavigation.description: Current responsibility, load, availability, and capability evidence.

primaryNavigation.label: Library
primaryNavigation.description: Artifacts, deliveries, decisions, reports, and prior versions.

primaryNavigation.label: Settings
primaryNavigation.description: Provider, approval policy, local runtime, data, and diagnostics.

intentContract.label: Message
intentContract.description: Conversation or context that does not request formal work.

intentContract.label: Question
intentContract.description: A request for an answer without an implied delivery lifecycle.

intentContract.label: Goal
intentContract.description: A requested outcome that may require a Goal Brief and formal work.

intentContract.label: Change direction
intentContract.description: A pause, stop, correction, new material, or scope change for existing work.

intentContract.label: Decision
intentContract.description: An explicit approval, rejection, or request for changes against a pending decision.

classificationResult.decisionReasonRule: Short auditable factual reason only; never private model reasoning or chain-of-thought.

actions.label: Continue editing
actions.description: Keep refining the goal or brief without starting work.

actions.label: Answer question
actions.description: Provide information that materially changes the expected result.

actions.label: Start
actions.description: Approve the current brief and begin formal work.

actions.label: Adjust
actions.description: Change the goal, scope, constraints, or expected delivery before execution.

actions.label: View progress
actions.description: Open high-signal progress without changing execution.

actions.label: Pause
actions.description: Pause new execution while preserving recoverable state.

actions.label: Resume
actions.description: Continue paused work from preserved state.

actions.label: Stop
actions.description: Cancel work without deleting retained evidence or prior artifacts.

actions.label: Resolve blocker
actions.description: Open the specific action needed to unblock work.

actions.label: Approve
actions.description: Explicitly allow the described high-impact action.

actions.label: Reject
actions.description: Decline the pending action without silently choosing an alternative.

actions.label: Request changes
actions.description: Return a decision or delivery with a specific requested change.

actions.label: View evidence
actions.description: Inspect verification evidence and reviewer findings.

actions.label: View changes
actions.description: Inspect what changed in the current revision.

actions.label: Open delivery
actions.description: Open the usable result and its acceptance evidence.

actions.label: Accept
actions.description: Accept the delivered result against its criteria.

actions.label: Retry
actions.description: Retry a failed operation without duplicating completed side effects.

actions.label: View diagnostics
actions.description: Inspect technical details in an explicitly diagnostic surface.

actions.label: View retained results
actions.description: Inspect artifacts and evidence retained after cancellation.

actions.label: Archive
actions.description: Remove completed work from active views without deleting its history.

states.label: Draft
states.description: The goal is still being edited or the brief is incomplete.
states.nextStep: Continue editing the goal or brief.

eventMappings.predicate: no valid Goal Brief or read-only legacy Charter view exists

states.label: Needs input
states.description: Information that materially affects the result is missing.
states.whyItMatters: Continuing would risk a materially wrong result.

states.label: Ready
states.description: The brief is valid and work can start.
states.whyItMatters: The expected result and boundaries are explicit.

eventMappings.predicate: data.blocking_question_count equals zero and the referenced Goal Brief version validates
no Goal Brief exists and the read-only legacy Charter view validates

states.label: Running
states.description: The team is executing and does not need user action.
states.whyItMatters: Work is progressing within the approved boundaries.

states.label: Paused
states.description: Execution is paused and recoverable state is preserved.
states.whyItMatters: No new execution should occur until the user resumes.

states.label: Blocked
states.description: Work cannot continue because of a specific blocker.
states.whyItMatters: Progress will not resume without resolving the blocker.

eventMappings.predicate: the blocked item prevents all remaining critical-path work; otherwise emit only an Attention Item

states.label: Needs approval
states.description: A high-impact action is waiting for an explicit decision.
states.whyItMatters: The action may change user-visible or external state.

states.label: Reviewing
states.description: The result is undergoing independent verification.
states.whyItMatters: The delivery is not yet ready for acceptance.

states.label: Revision
states.description: The team is revising a result in response to specific findings.
states.whyItMatters: The prior result did not satisfy at least one requirement.
states.nextStep: View the requested and completed changes.

states.label: Delivered
states.description: A usable result and its evidence are ready for acceptance.
states.whyItMatters: The user can now inspect the result against its criteria.

eventMappings.predicate: data contains a stable delivery id and version, at least one real openable Artifact ref exists in both artifact.created facts and storage, and acceptance is pending

states.label: Accepted
states.description: The delivery has been accepted by the user or explicit policy.
states.whyItMatters: The work has completed its acceptance lifecycle.

states.label: Failed
states.description: The current execution failed and cannot continue automatically.
states.whyItMatters: The failure needs a retry, correction, or stop decision.

states.label: Cancelled
states.description: The user stopped the work and no further execution will occur.
states.whyItMatters: Existing artifacts and evidence remain available.

prohibitedTerms.reason: Internal scheduling mechanics do not describe user value.
Raw runtime state is not a user state.
Internal projection architecture is not actionable user language.
User-visible state must explain impact and next action.
The normal path uses the provider name, not its internal identifier.
Template implementation boundaries are not a product feature.
Internal decomposition should be expressed through user outcomes.
The user acts on a decision, not an internal object.
Competitive scheduling language is not the user outcome.
Attempt counters belong in diagnostics unless needed to explain a failure.

fallbackRule.unknownInternalState: Do not infer success or a nearby user state. Emit a diagnostic warning and show an explicit unavailable state.
fallbackRule.missingReason: Do not fabricate a reason. State that the reason is unavailable and link to diagnostics.
fallbackRule.missingNextAction: Disable mutation controls until a valid action is provided by the projection contract.
